caption: How people think HODLing works
altText: A two-panel schematic drawing. The top panel, labelled how people think it is like to HODL, shows a cyclist on a completely flat road with a chequered finish flag ahead. The bottom panel, labelled what it is actually like, shows the same cyclist facing a long course of steep peaks, deep valleys, a water crossing, a tunnel and a rainstorm before reaching the flag.
